note: Integrated exclusive-channel cross section for numu-bar p -> mu+ p pi- (single-pion production on free protons) with an upper cut on the p-pi- invariant mass, from the HepData record's only table (Table 1). Two data points: sigma(M(p pi-) < 1.32 GeV) and sigma(M(p pi-) < 1.9 GeV), integrated over incident antineutrino energy 5-70 GeV (sqrt(s) 3.2-11.5 GeV). Target: free proton (H); reaction is explicitly on a free proton "P", not an average nucleon in a nucleus. From the HepData record.
